_comment: TDD M4 reasoning slice 1: raw model metadata.router is never a capability fact, so an injected effort.supported=false is ignored; with no override the caps are unknown-neutral and the literal passes exactly. RED before impl: diagnosed loss, strict 400 translation_loss, zero upstream IO.
name: m4_reasoning_chat_responses_metadata_router_ignored
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.respup]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-chat"
provider = "respup"
model = "gpt-4.1"
metadata = { label = "kept", router = { reasoning = { effort = { supported = false } } } }
